{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Vectors

|descr= Clamps vector values between provided min/max boundaries.

{{Feature|informative|This function can be used to clamp any [[Array]] of [[Number]]s (even though it is not its main usage).}}

|s1= [vector, min, max] call [[BIS_fnc_clampVector]]

|p1= vector: [[Vector3D]] - (Optional, default [0,0,0]) the vector to be clamped

|p2= min: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0)

|p3= max: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0)

|r1= [[Vector3D]] - the clamped ''vector''

|x1= <sqf>
private _newVelocity = [velocity vehicle player, -100, 100] call BIS_fnc_clampVector;
vehicle player setVelocity _newVelocity;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_clamp]] [[vectorNormalized]] [[vectorMultiply]]
}}
